kind: Read-only structural small-signal analysis of actual V4 native blocks and coefficients; no new native model changes or qualification runs.

physical_equations.coordinate: q = zS-zB, v = dq/dt, z positive away from workpiece
physical_equations.B_oscillator: mB*qdd = Kf*i - guideFriction(vA-vS+v) + mB*(g+aS) - k*q - c*qdot
physical_equations.mode_frequency: sqrt(k/mB)/(2*pi) in maintained point contact; S prescribed by surface constraint

sampled_loop_equations.discretization: Exact matrix exponential with zero-order held issued current command; native10us RK4 numerical error not reproduced.
sampled_loop_equations.sensor_transfer: H(z)=(1-alpha)/(z-alpha), alpha=exp(-Ts/filterTime). Native direct EMA followed by one-sample delay.
sampled_loop_equations.PI_transfer_A_per_N: Kp + Ki*Ts/(z-1), forward-Euler error integrator; saturation/antiwindup inactive
sampled_loop_equations.feedback_LP: Exact helper bilinear coefficients, applied only to PI/PID correction
sampled_loop_equations.effective_command_force_controller: Kf*C_PI*LP + s*(s+mu)/sqrt(1+s²), all multiplied by total-current notch when enabled
sampled_loop_equations.geometry_path: s*Rx_measured/Kf directly reacts to force outside feedback LP; frozen Rx=-N*(s+mu)/sqrt(1+s²)
sampled_loop_equations.saturation_limit: All calculations are local unsaturated; contact loss, travel stop, voltage/current clipping require native runs.

strategy_grid.kind: Exact sampled frozen-operating-point structural-loop calculation, not native closed-loop qualification

friction_ratio_physics.requires: Authorized reconstructed force vector and causal slope estimate with aligned transfers/timestamps, not known true mu.
friction_ratio_physics.guard: Update only Nhat>1 N with guarded denominator; hold otherwise.
friction_ratio_physics.startup: Flat contact s=0 makes initial mu irrelevant to axis-reference force; ratio learns from contact without bump timing.
friction_ratio_physics.small_signal_radial_cancellation: With frozen correct s and common transfer, both vector components scale with N, so d(mu_raw)/dN = 0. The geometry force-dependent feedback term disappears.
limits: Changing friction, mismatched channel phase/gain, normal-direction error, low-force division noise, and tangential tool dynamics must be qualified.
A frozen-ratio pole calculation does not represent the full nonlinear observer behavior.

native_stiffness_sensitivity_corresponde.interpretation: Matches stability pattern when guide speed leaves high-Coulomb-tangent near-zero region; not a prediction of exact failure timing. Native sidecars unchanged.

observer_damping_alternative.scope: Theoretical four-state predictor/damping alternative only; no native qualification, accel/position disturbances omitted in white-force-noise calculation

B_inertia_feedforward_caution.gamma_one: Cancels modeled B inertia, does not add modal damping; introduces an algebraic ideal limit and sensitivity to delay/model error.
B_inertia_feedforward_caution.preferred_if_needed: Use relative-velocity damping with predicted winding current and correctly modeled cell delay; modest current-lag compensation can be based on predicted relative acceleration.
B_inertia_feedforward_caution.damping_command: i_damp = -d_v*(qdot_hat+tauI*qdd_hat)/Kf, bounded and integrated with current clipping/antiwindup
B_inertia_feedforward_caution.observer_state_budget: 4 states including cell response, sufficient in native one-sample delay case; no surface preview required.

hardware_phase_interpretation.meaning: Native EMA filterTime is an identified discrete response assumption; at this sample rate it is not numerically the same phase as a continuous analog RC with that time constant. Installed phase response must fit the selected tested envelope.

scope_limits: All local calculations fix workpiece normal and active contact, prescribed tangential scan, frozen surface slope, and unsaturated current regulation.
The selected scalar cell stiffness and damping require loaded assembly identification; no manufacturer tolerance or real assembly modal damping has been established.
Stiffness ±10/20% and40–110MN/m are sensitivity brackets, not promised part tolerances.
ToolS mass affects disturbance and reconstruction noise but not this constrained-contact B-mode natural frequency. Real pad/contact compliance can introduce additional modes.
No new native simulations were run; analytical point counts must not be added to native qualification run counts.
Observer damping examples omit acceleration/position noise, profile variation, actuator mismatch, clipping, and loss-of-contact behavior. They are research alternatives only.

 b,a=control_coeff(kp,ki,0,lp,None,0,.3,False);Ac,Bc,Cc,Dc=tf2ss(b,a);nc=len(Ac)
 velocity=np.array([[0,wnom/knom,0,0]])
 acceleration=np.array([[-1/m,-2*wnom/(knom*m),1/m,0]])
 K=damping*(velocity+lead*acceleration)
 A=np.zeros((8+nc,8+nc));A[:4,:4]=Ap-Bp@Dc@Co;A[:4,4:4+nc]=-Bp@Cc;A[:4,4+nc:]=-Bp@K;A[4:4+nc,:4]=Bc@Co;A[4:4+nc,4:4+nc]=Ac;A[4+nc:,:4]=(L-Bobs@Dc)@Co;A[4+nc:,4:4+nc]=-Bobs@Cc;A[4+nc:,4+nc:]=Aobs-L@Co-Bobs@K
 poles=np.linalg.eigvals(A);rate=np.log(poles.astype(complex))/Ts;freq=np.abs(rate.imag)/(2*np.pi);mp=rate[(freq>500)&(freq<3500)];mode=mp[np.argmax(mp.real)]
 row={'k_N_m':k,'modal_velocity_gain_N_s_m':damping,'current_inverse_lead_s':lead,'feedback_lp':lp,'kp':kp,'stable':bool(max(abs(poles))<1),'largest_growth_rate_per_s':float(max(rate.real)),'structural_mode_growth_rate_per_s':float(mode.real),'structural_mode_frequency_Hz':float(abs(mode.imag)/(2*np.pi))}
 # Measurement noise added after sensor output; observer and controller see it simultaneously.
 W=np.r_[-Bp@Dc,Bc,L-Bobs@Dc]
 if row['stable']:
  P=solve_discrete_lyapunov(A,W@W.T*.02**2)
